Residential plots in a phased development
Landscape and tree planting form a central part of the plan
Developer described water conservation infrastructure
projects.hold: Resolve the 120 versus 121 acre scope. Match individual plot, phase, services, completion information and registration. Phase 5 references found in secondary records are not cleared for automatic publication.

Multiple residential blocks with different home formats
80 plus amenities described by Brigade
Sports and shared recreation within the township proposition
projects.hold: Select a registered block before using size, availability or possession fields. The corporate page mixes a Beryl heading and sold-out label with township-wide content. Do not apply one block status to every block.

Developer described smart home features
Miyawaki inspired landscape component
Thanisandra Main Road location

Two clubhouses with recreation and fitness functions
Central landscaped areas
Phase specific apartment choices

Separate row house villament and apartment formats
Three and four bedroom row houses
Backyard and terrace spaces in documented row house plans

Landscaped residential setting
